presentation.title: Who am I?
presentation.section1: With a genuine passion for new technologies, I stand out through an innovative vision in improving the tools and processes of a profession, particularly in the context of France's digital transition.
presentation.section2: My goal is to create high-value technical solutions, never losing sight of the human being behind the screen.
presentation.section3_title: An atypical career path, a constant passion
presentation.section3_part1: With a solid background in engineering, robotics, and computer science, I have built my profile on varied technical foundations: mechanical engineering, production management, web development, and cloud computing.
presentation.section3_part2: From the Mediterranean Institute of Robotics and Computer Science Studies and Research in Perpignan to a recent certification as a confirmed Angular developer, I have always sought to evolve my skills, driven by insatiable curiosity and a genuine taste for challenge.
presentation.section4_title: A developer... and a proud geek!
presentation.section4_part1: I am a 37-year-old full stack developer, but also a geek culture enthusiast. If I'm not coding or experimenting with a new framework, you'll probably find me playing an indie game, binge-watching a science fiction series, or discussing the world over coffee, talking about music, cinema, or the evolution of AI.
presentation.section4_part2: My approach to development is deeply human: I love to collaborate, exchange, learn, and share knowledge.
presentation.section5_title: From design to deployment: a 360° vision
presentation.section5_part1: Specializing in technology stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, Angular, and TypeScript, I am now complementing my expertise with strong DevOps skills (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).
presentation.section5_part2: My goal? To be able to design an application from A to Z, from front-end to cloud deployment, while maintaining an agile and user-focused mindset.

contact.monologue_question: would say, "Is it a good job, scribe?"
contact.monologue: Well, you know, I don't think there are good or bad situations. If I were to summarize my life today with you, I would say that first of all, there are encounters, people who lent me a hand, perhaps at a time when I couldn't, when I was alone at home. And it's quite curious to say that chances, encounters forge a destiny... Because when you have a passion for something, when you have a taste for doing things well, the beautiful gesture, sometimes you don't find the right person in front of you, I would say, the mirror that helps you move forward. So that's not my case, as I was saying, because on the contrary, I could; and I say thank you to life, I say thank you to it, I sing life, I dance life... I am only love! And finally, when many people today ask me: "But how do you have this humanity?" Well, I answer them very simply, I tell them that it's this taste for love, this taste that pushed me today to undertake a mechanical construction, but tomorrow, who knows, perhaps simply to serve the community, to give, to give of oneself...
